note: Manual test cases drafted by Devin for stories in the QA pilot (JD-146). Xray is not installed on this Jira, so the keys below are the ones referenced by the `xray` annotation in the specs; when Xray is available, create these as Test issues linked to the story and replace the keys.

tests.summary: Transfer of exactly the daily limit is accepted
tests.precondition: Persona daily.limit exists. Its Everyday Current Account has a balance above its daily limit (seed: 1500 balance, 1000 limit) and a second account (eSaver) to receive the money
steps: Choose Everyday Current Account as From and eSaver as To
Enter an amount equal to the daily limit (1000)
tests.expected: Success message 'Transfer of £1,000.00 sent. New balance £500.00.' is shown, no error is shown, and the Accounts overview shows the From account at £500.00 and eSaver increased by £1,000.00

tests.summary: Transfer of one pound over the daily limit is rejected with 'Daily limit is <limit>'
tests.precondition: Persona daily.limit exists. Its Everyday Current Account has a balance above its daily limit plus one pound (seed: 1500 balance, 1000 limit), so the rejection is caused by the limit and not by insufficient funds
steps: Choose Everyday Current Account as From and eSaver as To
Enter an amount one pound over the daily limit (1001)
tests.expected: Error 'Daily limit is 1000' is shown, no success message is shown, and the Accounts overview still shows both balances unchanged
